Priyanka Singh: I'll collect shipping addresses. DM me by Wed. For APAC, shipping is slow so maybe e-gift cards there.

Alex Kim: Yep, I'll grab a vegan cake from GreenSlice at 2:45pm and bring to conf B.
Jordan Lee: Can someone take candid photos in person? I need some stills for the montage.
Alex Kim: I got photos.
BirthdayBot: Reminder set: "Tanya 30th surprise" 2025-05-12 14:45 ET. :bell:
Priya Rao: @here react :thumbsup: if you can join the Zoom at 3pm ET, or :wave: if you'll send a clip but can't make it live.
